result.instructions: Tools for Codat, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Codat data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run codat_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run codat_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run codat_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. codat_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: codat_get_profile
tools.title: Get account profile
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated Codat account's profile (organization name, redirect URLs, features) — a quick way to verify the API key works. Codat API: GET /profile.

tools.name: codat_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies in your Codat account. A company represents one of your customers' businesses and holds its data connections. Codat API: GET /companies. Returns the paged envelope { results, pageNumber, pageSize, totalResults, _links }.

query.description: Codat query filter string, e.g. "status=Paid" or "modifiedDate>2026-01-01". See docs.codat.io/using-the-api/querying.

orderBy.description: Field to order results by, e.g. "-modifiedDate" (leading "-" for descending).

tools.name: codat_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Fetch a single company by id (name, platform, dataConnections, created/lastSync). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}.

tools.name: codat_list_connections
tools.title: List data connections
tools.description: List a company's data connections (each links the company to one source platform, e.g. QuickBooks, Xero). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections. Returns the paged envelope.

query.description: Codat query filter string, e.g. "status=Paid" or "modifiedDate>2026-01-01". See docs.codat.io/using-the-api/querying.

orderBy.description: Field to order results by, e.g. "-modifiedDate" (leading "-" for descending).

tools.name: codat_get_connection
tools.title: Get a data connection
tools.description: Fetch a single data connection by id (platformKey, status, sourceType, lastSync). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections/{connectionId}.

connectionId.description: The Codat connectionId (data connection UUID) within the company.

tools.name: codat_get_balance_sheet
tools.title: Get balance sheet

periodLength.description: Number of months per period (1-12). Required.

periodsToCompare.description: How many periods to return (1-12). Required.

startMonth.description: First month of the earliest period (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the most recent.

tools.name: codat_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Codat API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Path starts with a slash (e.g. "/companies/{id}/data/taxRates", "/companies/{id}/reports/agedDebtor"). Codat API: GET {path}.

path.description: API path starting with a slash, e.g. "/companies/{id}/data/items".

tools.name: codat_create_company
tools.title: Create a company
tools.description: MUTATES Codat data — create a new company (a container for a customer's data connections). Provide a name; optionally a description, tags, or other attributes via `fields`. Codat API: POST /companies. Returns the created company (incl. its id).

name.description: A human-readable name for the company (usually your customer's business name).

description.description: Optional description / notes for the company.

fields.description: Additional raw Codat fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

tools.name: codat_create_connection
tools.title: Create a data connection
tools.description: MUTATES Codat data — create a new data connection on a company for a given source platform. Provide the platformKey (from codat_list_integrations, e.g. "gbol" for QuickBooks Online sandbox). The connection is created in a PendingAuth state; the customer completes authorization via the returned linkUrl. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/connections. Returns the created connection.

platformKey.description: The integration platformKey to connect (from codat_list_integrations).

fields.description: Additional raw Codat fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

tools.name: codat_refresh_all_data
tools.title: Queue a full data refresh
tools.description: MUTATES Codat state — queue a refresh of ALL data types for a company (Codat re-pulls from the connected source platforms). Asynchronous: it enqueues pulls, it does not return the data. Use codat_get_data_status to track progress. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/data/all.

tools.name: codat_refresh_data_type
tools.title: Queue a single dataset refresh
tools.description: MUTATES Codat state — queue a refresh of ONE data type for a company (e.g. "invoices", "bills", "chartOfAccounts", "balanceSheet"). Asynchronous: it enqueues a pull, it does not return the data. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/data/queue/{dataType}.

dataType.description: The Codat data type key to refresh, e.g. "invoices", "bills", "customers", "chartOfAccounts", "balanceSheet".
